script.title: PICKING LAUNDRY DETERGENT
script.story_hook: Choosing the right detergent in a huge store aisle.
script.intro_zh: 在賣場一整排洗衣精貨架前挑對那一罐。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, friends! Today we're shopping smart — choosing laundry detergent in English.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，朋友們！今天邊逛邊學——用英文挑洗衣精。
script.outro: That's all for today! Hear it once more, then join us next time.
script.outro_zh: 今天就到這裡！再聽一遍，然後我們下次見。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's practice together — say each sentence after me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 一起來練習——跟著我一句一句說出來。
script.char_a_description: a tired-looking white woman in her mid-forties with a shoulder-length auburn bob, wearing an olive rain jacket over a striped tee, pushing a half-full shopping cart and clutching a small laundry basket
script.char_b_description: a tidy South Asian man in his early thirties with a close-cropped black haircut and a thin mustache, wearing a blue store vest with a name tag over a grey polo, stacking detergent boxes with quick neat motions
script.youtube_title: 【🧺🧴洗衣精怎麼挑】「膠囊跟液體哪個好？」超實用賣場英文，聽完就會逛超市｜🛒Choosing Detergent English

A shopper finds the right aisle, checks HE-machine labels, compares pods with liquid, and handles a sold-out surprise — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA. Repeat every line in the second half and shop in English today.

Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🧺挑洗衣精英文｜找貨道・比較劑型・缺貨替代｜聽完就會逛賣場｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
站在一整排洗衣精前面，到底該怎麼選？
無香、膠囊、HE 專用，用英文該怎麼問？

這一集帶大家走進超市的洗護用品走道，跟著顧客從找貨道、確認洗衣機規格、比較膠囊與液體，到缺貨時改用液態配方，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🧴 找商品與看規格：例如「Excuse me, where do you keep detergent?」、「see the little HE logo?」。
🌿 膚質與配方選擇：例如「My skin is pretty sensitive, though.」、「go unscented then — it's gentler.」。
📦 缺貨與改買替代：例如「Unscented pods are sold out.」、「When will they come back in?」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

看完記得實戰一次，原來挑瓶洗衣精可以這麼輕鬆！
script.thumbnail_action: holding a pod box in one hand and a liquid jug in the other

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, where do you keep detergent?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz mi wɛr du ju kip dɪˈtɜrdʒənt/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，請問洗衣精放在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Aisle six, on your right, next to the soap.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl sɪks ɑn jɔr raɪt nɛkst tə ðə soʊp/
dialogue.zh: 在六號走道，你的右手邊，緊挨著肥皂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks! Which one works for an HE machine?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks wɪtʃ wʌn wɜrks fɚ ən eɪtʃ i məˈʃin/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！哪一款適用於 HE 洗衣機？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most of these do; see the little HE logo?
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst əv ðiz du si ðə ˈlɪtəl eɪtʃ i ˈloʊɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 這幾排大多都可以；看到小小的 HE 標誌了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. My skin is pretty sensitive, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt maɪ skɪn ɪz ˈprɪti ˈsɛnsɪtɪv ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 看到了。不過我的皮膚還滿敏感的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, go unscented then — it's gentler.
dialogue.zh: 那就選無香型吧——會更溫和。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good tip. Are pods better than liquid?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tɪp ɑr pɑdz ˈbɛtɚ ðæn ˈlɪkwɪd/
dialogue.zh: 好建議。膠囊比液體的更好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pods are easier; liquid handles tough stains.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɑdz ɑr ˈiziər ˈlɪkwɪd ˈhændəls tʌf steɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 膠囊比較方便，液體對付頑強污漬更強。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, I mostly wash my gym clothes.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm aɪ ˈmoʊstli wɑʃ maɪ dʒɪm kloʊðz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then try liquid. Unscented pods are sold out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn traɪ ˈlɪkwɪd ʌnˈsɛntɪd pɑdz ɑr soʊld aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 那就試試液體的。無香型膠囊剛好賣完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sold out? When will they come back in?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊld aʊt wɛn wɪl ðeɪ kʌm bæk ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 賣完了？他們什麼時候會補貨？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honestly, maybe next week; restocks run late.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəstli ˈmeɪbi nɛkst wik ˈriˌstɑks rʌn leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，可能要下週；補貨常常會慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll grab the liquid today instead.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪl ɡræb ðə ˈlɪkwɪd təˈdeɪ ɪnˈstɛd/
dialogue.zh: 好吧，那我今天就先買液體的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. This one's the gentlest formula here.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt ðɪs wʌnz ðə ˈdʒɛntləst ˈfɔrmjə hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。這罐是這裡最溫和的配方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the big jug worth the extra money?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə bɪɡ dʒʌɡ wɜrθ ðə ˈɛkstrə ˈmʌni/
dialogue.zh: 大桶裝的值得多花那些錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: If you wash a lot, the big one pays off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf ju wɑʃ ə lɑt ðə bɪɡ wʌn peɪz ɑf/
dialogue.zh: 如果你常洗衣服，大桶的比較划算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sold. Thanks for helping me figure it out.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɑld θæŋks fɚ ˈhɛlpiŋ mi ˈfɪɡər ɪt aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 就買它了。謝謝你幫我弄清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime! Come back if you have questions.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛnəˌtaɪm kʊm bæk ɪf ju hæv ˈkwɛstʃənz/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣！有問題歡迎再來問。
